requirement.original: Fix Issue #6: BashView scrollbar + bottom border-radius conflict in the Happy App.
requirement.clarified: Remove BashView's redundant overflow:hidden and borderRadius, rely on parent ToolView's borderRadius:8 + overflow:hidden for corner clipping, and enable horizontal scrollbar on the ScrollView.
requirement.what: Fix CSS conflict between horizontal scrollbar visibility and bottom border-radius in BashView component
requirement.why: BashView inline preview either clips the scrollbar (with overflow:hidden) or loses rounded bottom corners (without it). Two previous fix attempts failed.

included: Maintain rounded bottom corners on tool card
Verify on desktop and mobile viewports

success_criteria: Horizontal scrollbar is visible and functional when bash output overflows
Bottom corners of tool card appear rounded (8px from ToolView)
No scrollbar/text overlap with +N more lines indicator
Works on both desktop (1280px+) and mobile (390px) viewports
constraints: Cannot modify ToolView (shared by all tool types)
Must verify with Playwright on live content

root_cause_analysis.symptom: BashView horizontal scrollbar is clipped/hidden when borderBottomLeftRadius + overflow:hidden are set on the container. Removing them fixes scrollbar but breaks rounded corners.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: BashView.container has overflow:hidden to enforce its own borderBottomLeftRadius:11, but this also clips the ScrollView's horizontal scrollbar. The overflow:hidden + borderRadius are redundant because the parent ToolView.container (borderRadius:8, overflow:hidden) already provides corner clipping, and BashView's negative margins align it with ToolView's edges.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: a529bf91 - current reverted state with border-radius + overflow:hidden + scrollbar disabled
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: borderBottomLeftRadius:11 and overflow:hidden were added to BashView to give the terminal block rounded bottom corners matching the card shape
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: overflow:hidden on BashView clips the horizontal scrollbar that the ScrollView needs to display. The border-radius was duplicating work already done by the parent ToolView.container.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Original bug existed since BashView creation. Fix attempt 1 (79c915b2) removed radius/overflow, broke corners. Fix attempt 2 (7216dd70) reverted. Reverted to a529bf91.

context.codebase_state: Reverted to a529bf91 state. BashView has borderBottomLeftRadius:11, borderBottomRightRadius:11, overflow:hidden on container, scrollbar disabled.
context.recent_commits: 7216dd70 reverted failed fix, 79c915b2 was failed fix (removed radius/overflow), a529bf91 is baseline

development_approach.strategy: Remove BashView's redundant overflow:hidden and borderRadius properties. The parent ToolView.container already has borderRadius:8 + overflow:hidden which clips all child content including BashView (whose negative margins align it with ToolView's edges). Then enable showsHorizontalScrollIndicator on the ScrollView.

specific_changes.reason: Enable the horizontal scrollbar so users can see overflowing content

specific_changes.change: Lines 90-92: Remove borderBottomLeftRadius:11, borderBottomRightRadius:11, and overflow:'hidden' from styles.container
specific_changes.reason: These are redundant with ToolView.container's borderRadius:8 + overflow:hidden, and overflow:hidden clips the scrollbar

development_approach.validation_approach: Playwright E2E on dev.life-ai.app: (1) Find a bash tool call with wide output, verify scrollbar visible. (2) Find a short bash tool call, verify bottom corners rounded. (3) Test on both 1280x720 and 390x844 viewports.

research_findings.reason: Straightforward CSS/layout bug with clear root cause identified from component hierarchy analysis and two failed fix attempts providing empirical evidence.
